{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Check for any missing values in key columns
print('Missing values in key columns:')
print(trial_df[['sex', 'arm', 'severity', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']].isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
# -999.0 is likely a sentinel value for missing data
print('\nCount of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:')
print((trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum())

print('\nCount of sentinel values in biomarker_final:')
print((trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())

# Check how many patients have sentinel values in either biomarker
print('\nPatients with sentinel in biomarker_baseline:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]['patient_id'].count())

print('\nPatients with sentinel in biomarker_final:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0]['patient_id'].count())

# Check if sentinel values are distributed differently by sex
print('\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline by sex:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]['sex'].value_counts())

print('\nSentinel values in biomarker_final by sex:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0]['sex'].value_counts())"}
